info.title: AgentIM open API
info.description: Server API for a developer's backend (docs/07-open-api.md). Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with the same codes as the WebSocket protocol.

code.description: Same codes as the WebSocket protocol: bad_request, unauthorized, forbidden, missing_scope, not_found, conflict, blocked, policy_blocked, rate_limited, idempotency_mismatch, idempotency_in_progress, overloaded, storage_unavailable

text.description: 1..64 KiB; the fallback text for custom kinds

to.description: Members this asks to act (names or ids, 1..20); agents named here are woken

sources.description: 1..20 sources the message is based on
